Only a neighboring-zone acceptance rate guardrail is listed, and it has no threshold.","evidence_quote":"Driver Acceptance Rate in neighboring zones: should not drop.","citations":["guardrail-standards#driver-pay-and-incentives"],"recommendation":"Add Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate and Cost Per Delivery as guardrails with explicit stop thresholds."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-021 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-021 already tested a peak-hour surge incentive. It found interference in adjacent zones and a cost increase, and recommended market or switchback designs. The proposal does not reference or learn from it.","evidence_quote":"Launch a surge incentive during peak hours across all markets and watch the dashboard.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-021, explain what differs, and adopt its learnings (market or switchback design, neighbor tracking, cost tracking)."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No Legal and Compensation review recorded","detail":"Surge incentives alter driver pay, which requires Legal and Compensation review because of classification and pay-transparency risk. The proposal states no reviews.","evidence_quote":"## Reviews And Dependencies\nNone.","citations":["policy-compliance#driver-compensation-and-classification"],"recommendation":"Obtain and record Legal and Compensation review before launch."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No experiment plan; full rollout with dashboard monitoring","detail":"There is no control, randomization design, duration, MDE, power or stopping rule. Pay changes need switchback, geo or market-level designs, a minimum of 14 days, and pre-registration. Watching a dashboard does not meet these standards.","evidence_quote":"None. We will roll out to all markets and monitor the dashboard.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration","experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference","experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Design a market-level or switchback test of at least 14 days with a pre-registered primary metric, MDE, power and stopping rule."}]}
